parsed.reason: Description A says the removed mark_as_failure call means the conversion error is no longer stored in the result backend, so clients never see the failure. Description B says the handler lacks a return after reject, so the task falls through and executes immediately ignoring its ETA; it also mentions the result-backend omission only as a secondary point. The core defects differ: A is about missing result-backend recording, while B is about control flow causing immediate execution. Both sit at the same lines, but they name different failures.
